camel_example: aliyun agenthitldata ListApprovals --region cn-hangzhou --ViewType MyApprovals --version 2026-08-10 --method POST --force
description_en: Performs a paged query for the approval summary by view, supporting paging and filtering by approval status. You can invoke GetApprovalDetail with the returned approval ID to view the operation plan and approver information
description_zh: 按视图分页查询审批单摘要，可按审批状态筛选。使用返回的审批单 ID 调用 GetApprovalDetail，可查看操作计划和审批人信息
name: ListApprovals

parameters.help_en:
The query view. Valid values:
MyApprovals: queries approvals initiated by the current principal.
MyAssignedApprovals: queries approvals assigned to the current principal.
AllApprovals: queries all approvals in the current tenant. Required permissions are needed
parameters.help_zh:
查询视图。
MyApprovals 查询当前主体发起的审批单。
MyAssignedApprovals 查询指定当前主体审批的单据。
AllApprovals 查询当前租户的全部审批单，需具备相应权限
parameters.name: view_type

parameters.help_en:
Filters approvals by status. If this parameter is omitted, approvals in all statuses are queried. Valid values:
PENDING: pending
APPROVED: approved
REJECTED: rejected
RECALLED: recalled
EXPIRED: expired
parameters.help_zh:
按审批状态筛选。省略时查询所有状态。
PENDING 表示待处理。
APPROVED 表示已同意。
REJECTED 表示已拒绝。
RECALLED 表示已撤回
EXPIRED 表示已过期
parameters.name: status_filter

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of approvals to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页最多返回的审批单数量。取值为 1 至 100 的整数，默认值为 10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Omit this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, pass the NextToken value returned from the previous page. If you change the region, account, calling principal, query view, or status filter, restart the query from the first page. The example is masked
parameters.help_zh: 翻页标记。首次查询时省略。续页时原样传入上一页返回的 NextToken。切换地域、账号、调用主体、查询视图或状态筛选条件时从首页重新查询。示例已脱敏
parameters.name: next_token

schema.description_en: The list of approval summaries and pagination information returned when the query is successful
schema.description_zh: 查询成功时返回的审批单摘要列表和分页信息

Approvals.description_en: The list of approval summaries on the current page
Approvals.description_zh: 当前页的审批单摘要列表

ApprovalReqId.description_en: The approval ID. You can use this ID to query approval details or process the approval
ApprovalReqId.description_zh: 审批单 ID。使用此 ID 查询审批详情或处理该审批单

ClientAgentName.description_en: The name of the client agent that initiated the operation
ClientAgentName.description_zh: 发起本次操作的客户端 Agent 名称

CreatedAt.description_en: The creation time of the approval. Approvals created in a region use UTC time. The Z in the example indicates UTC
CreatedAt.description_zh: 审批单的创建时间。地域内创建的审批单使用 UTC 时间，示例中的 Z 表示 UTC

ExpiredAt.description_en: The expiration time of the approval. Approvals created in a region use UTC time. The Z in the example indicates UTC
ExpiredAt.description_zh: 审批单的到期时间。地域内创建的审批单使用 UTC 时间，示例中的 Z 表示 UTC

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud region to which the approval belongs
RegionId.description_zh: 审批单所属的阿里云地域 ID

RequesterPrincipalId.description_en: The identifier of the principal that initiated the approval. This identifier is used together with RequesterPrincipalType to identify the initiator
RequesterPrincipalId.description_zh: 审批单发起主体的标识，与 RequesterPrincipalType 一起标识发起人

RequesterPrincipalType.description_en:
The type of the principal that initiated the approval. Valid values:
sub: RAM user
customer: Alibaba Cloud account
AssumedRoleUser: session principal that assumes a RAM role
RequesterPrincipalType.description_zh:
审批单发起主体的类型。
sub 表示 RAM 用户
customer 表示阿里云主账号
AssumedRoleUser 表示扮演 RAM 角色的会话主体

RiskSummary.description_en: The risk summary of the operation plan, which outlines the actions in the plan and the actions that require approval
RiskSummary.description_zh: 本次操作计划的风险摘要，概括计划中的动作及需要审批的动作
RiskSummary.example: 本次共 1 项动作，全部需要审批：调用 ecs API 1 项。

ServerAgentName.description_en: The name of the server agent involved in the operation
ServerAgentName.description_zh: 本次操作涉及的服务端 Agent 名称

Status.description_en:
The current status of the approval. Valid values:
PENDING: pending
APPROVED: approved
REJECTED: rejected
RECALLED: recalled
EXPIRED: expired
Status.description_zh:
审批单当前状态。
PENDING 表示待处理。
APPROVED 表示已同意。
REJECTED 表示已拒绝。
RECALLED 表示已撤回
EXPIRED 表示已过期

Title.description_en: The title of the approval, which outlines the operation plan submitted for approval
Title.description_zh: 审批单标题，概括本次提交审批的操作计划
Title.example: 清理测试环境的 ECS 实例

IsTruncated.description_en:
Indicates whether more pages are available. Valid values:
true: More pages are available. You can use the returned NextToken to continue the query.
false: The last page is reached
IsTruncated.description_zh: 是否还有下一页。true 表示还有下一页，可使用返回的 NextToken 继续查询。false 表示已到末页

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of approvals returned per page in the current query
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次查询每页最多返回的审批单数量

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. If IsTruncated is true, pass this value as is in the next ListApprovals request. No pagination token is returned for the last page. The example is masked
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页的翻页标记。IsTruncated 为 true 时，在下一次 ListApprovals 请求中原样传入此值。末页无续页标记。示例已脱敏

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use this ID to correlate requests and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次 API 请求的标识，用于关联请求和排查问题
